subject: Private fleet maintenance: proposed freeze window, canary lane, and rollback rehearsal
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <ops@medicore.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <security@enterprisebank.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Private fleet maintenance: proposed freeze window, canary lane, and rollback rehearsal

Hi team —

We need to lock down the upgrade plan for Mercantile Bank's private deployment. High level proposal below; please flag gaps. I want to run a full rehearsal (dry-run) and a live canary next week so we have rollback confidence before the month-end pin change.

Proposal (draft):
- Freeze window: 2026-06-15 02:00–06:00 UTC (low traffic).
- Canary lane: 1 pod / 2 hours, telemetry gating (latency p95, error rate, token success).
- Version pin: target rollout to v2.8.1; keep v2.7.6 pinned for fallback 1.
- Rollback rehearsals: two scenarios (fast revert + staged shelve).
- Primary owner: Karthik (rollback/runbook), Ops partner: Samir (networks & maintenance bridge).

Deliverables before rehearsal:
1) Finalized runbook (attached draft v1).
2) Canary metrics checklist (attached).
3) Jira ticket with playcall and on-call roster (OPS-4128).

Questions for ops/security: can you confirm acceptance SLA for a 4-hour narrow freeze? Any network-maintenance blackout we should avoid?

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Product Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <ops@medicore.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <security@enterprisebank.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Private fleet maintenance: proposed freeze window, canary lane, and rollback rehearsal

Thanks Jasmine — good starting point. A few technical notes and clarifications: 

1) Rollback paths: we should codify two explicit procedures in the runbook (with exact CLI/API commands):
   - Fast revert: switch routing to pinned v2.7.6 via feature-router (expected <90s to complete, requires KV-cache flush).
   - Staged shelve: drain pods on new version and move traffic back gradually; works if we need partial rollback for specific tenants.

2) Preconditions for canary:
   - KV cache snapshot + backup (store S3 path in runbook).
   - Snapshot of model artifacts and quantization metadata.
   - Telemetry hooks: token-level latency and generation error events must be streaming to canary dashboard.

3) Network considerations: Samir, confirm if Mercantile's ACL change window is aligned with proposed freeze — they recently had an automated BGP refresh on the 12th. If not, we should move to 06-16.

4) Abort criteria (propose thresholds to put in runbook):
   - p95 latency increase > 30% for 10min 
   - error rate > 2% sustained for 5min 
   - anomalous token output rate (regression) flagged by quality evals

I'll take ownership of the rollback procedures and add the exact commands to the runbook draft by EOD 6/2.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Samir Gupta <ops@medicore.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <security@enterprisebank.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T02:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Private fleet maintenance: proposed freeze window, canary lane, and rollback rehearsal

Jasmine — Samir from Medicore ops. We can support 2026-06-15 02:00–06:00 UTC but two items to note from our side:

1) Network maintenance: Mercantile has a scheduled BGP route validation on 2026-06-14 23:00–01:00 UTC (their local ops). That should not overlap with your freeze but raises a small window risk. If you keep the 15th start time, ensure we have bridge + route verification at start.

2) Bridge hosting & recordings: we will host the maintenance bridge (Zoom link in Jira). We will also record the canary telemetry snapshot and provide an ops-checklist artifact after the rehearsal.

Attachments: runbook draft (version you sent, we added an operations appendix), canary metrics checklist (filled example).

Samir Gupta
Head of Site Ops, Medicore Managed Services
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <ops@medicore.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T14:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Private fleet maintenance: proposed freeze window, canary lane, and rollback rehearsal

Quick scheduling confirmation and a couple of operational asks: 

- I can staff the maintenance bridge for the rehearsal on 6/10 08:00–10:00 UTC (dry-run), which gives us five working days before the live freeze. Can we make 6/10 a rehearsal date and 6/15 the live window?
- Please add the on-call mobile numbers to the Jira OPS-4128 ticket.
- Karthik: who owns the canary alert runbook during the two-hour canary? I can be secondary.

If everyone agrees, I'll update the runbook with the rehearsal schedule and preflight checklist items (KV snapshot, model artifact verifications, smoke tests).

Monica
Monica Patel
Support & Escalations Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <ops@medicore.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <security@enterprisebank.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T16:43:00Z
Subject: Re: Private fleet maintenance: proposed freeze window, canary lane, and rollback rehearsal

All — good alignment. Plan moving forward:

1) Rehearsal (dry-run): 2026-06-10 08:00–10:00 UTC (Monica bridge lead).
2) Live freeze: 2026-06-15 02:00–06:00 UTC (Samir hosting the bridge).
3) Owners: Karthik (rollback procedures & runbook finalize), Monica (bridge & smoke tests), Samir (network & recording).
4) Preflight checklist (to be completed 24h before rehearsal):
   - KV snapshot + S3 backup OK (owner: Karthik)
   - Model artifact snapshot + integrity hash (owner: Karthik)
   - Canary metrics dashboard wired to OPS-4128 (owner: Monica)
   - Runbook v1 finalized and uploaded (owner: Jasmine)

I've attached the updated runbook and the example canary metrics checklist. Laura — please let us know if Mercantile security requires additional evidence (audit logs or longer retention) during the rehearsal. We'll retain recordings and telemetry for 30 days for post-mortem.

If no objections by EOD 6/05, I'll mark the Jira ticket as preflight-scheduled and send calendar invites.

Thanks —
Jasmine

On Thu, 4 Jun 2026 at 16:43, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Laura — please let us know if Mercantile security requires additional evidence (audit logs or longer retention) during the rehearsal.

Jasmine — thanks for the heads up. We require the following for the rehearsal and live event: 
- Audit logs for all admin/API actions during the window (immutable export).
- Vault access events for key rotations (if any).
- Bridge recordings and checksum of runbook used.

If you provide the artifacts within 48h of the rehearsal we are fine. We do not require extended retention beyond 90 days for this event.

Laura Chen
Director, Information Security — Mercantile Bank
